Name: Ancient Seed Germinator
Author: proudunicorn
Description:
Put ANY piece of fruit + an ancient seed (the artifact) into this machine and get a random amount of ancient fruit seeds or mixed seeds out!

Fruit is the input, and the ancient seed is the fuel.

If you put a higher quality fruit in the machine, you will get more seeds out, just like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5003]Better Quality Increased Seeds[/url].

Recipe can be bought from the carpentry shop once all the requirements have been met. See article for more info.

Works great with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3012]Better Mixed Seeds[/url].

[u][size=4]Permissions:[/size][/u]

Anyone who wants to target my machine in their ProducerRules is welcome to do so, so long as it does not conflict with the ProducerRules in this mod, including future updates.

It is basically a second seed maker, so if you want your object to produce a different set of outputs as well as the outputs in the vanilla machine, this might be useful.
